title: first time poster, long time lurker.

posts.author: Looey
posts.body:
Hey there! i've actually been lurking on these forums on and off for the last 2-4 years and only really decided to make an account now. knowing me though i might just lurk again and post once a solar eclipse ;u;
i'll be honest i just wanted a profile pic so that's why im posting here
but hey! im Looey, I am primarily a full time artist but i tend to dabble in game design and development!
im not new to making games and rpg maker. i've been dabbling with the software since XP but never really made anything until the 2020s. i made a full game with MV two years ago (with a big help from browsing these forums) and decided to start working on a new project as of recent. so i've been browsing the forums again
and uh, thats it for now! i dont think i'll be posting a lot here but i definitely do lurk alot! nice to meet y'all
